title: Python dropped fragmentation senders retain prepared reservations until TTL
description: Security review: SchcSessionManager.create_sender stores a strong reference to each FragmentSender in _prepared, so dropping the returned handle cannot trigger the global weakref cleanup and does not call discard_prepared. Repeating create-and-drop fills MAX_PREPARED_SENDERS and blocks valid transfers for PREPARED_SENDER_TTL_SECONDS. Provide deterministic handle-drop/cancellation cleanup (or a lease API that cannot be abandoned), without unsafe destructor exceptions, and test capacity recovery after dropped never-started handles.
notes: The same ownership model retains active records after the caller drops its only handle; include active-session drop cleanup/terminal hold-down semantics in the fix and tests.
